Code Charts

Block maps for the Base and Extended spaces.

Charts are generated from the machine-instruction database (Blocks.txt, NamesList.txt, PropList.txt). 0.1.0 publishes the block map; per-codepoint printable charts ship as native allocations are assigned in 0.2.0.
